effect.name: GM Prism Warp
effect.desc: Angle-controlled refractive prism split with smooth radial masking.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 d=vec2(cos(angle),sin(angle));float m=smoothstep(0.0,max(softness,0.0001),abs(dot(u-vec2(0.5),vec2(-d.y,d.x))));vec2 o=d*amount*m;vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,u);vec4 r=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u+o*dispersion,0.0,1.0));vec4 b=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u-o*dispersion,0.0,1.0));gl_FragColor=vec4(r.r,s.g,b.b,s.a);}
